null if none. - quarterly_win_rate (%): 100 times distinct Won divided by distinct Won+Lost; returns 0 if no Won+Lost. - active_sales_reps_in_quarter: distinct owner_id across all deals; null owner_id excluded. - Build forecast_metrics (fm), grouped by created_year, created_quarter: - total_open_pipeline: sum of deal_amount for Open deals; business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__owner_performance_metrics and retain only owners where total_deals > 0. - Build monthly deal performance per owner from intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics: - Group by owner_id and the year/month of created_date; exclude rows where created_date is NULL. - monthly_deals_created: count distinct deal_id per month. - monthly_deals_won: count distinct deal_id where deal_status = ''Won''. - monthly_revenue: sum deal_amount where deal_status = ''Won'' (0 otherwise). - monthly_pipeline_added: sum deal_amount where deal_status = ''Open'' (0 otherwise). - monthly_win_rate: if decided deals (Won or Lost) exist, compute 100 × (won / decided); otherwise 0. - monthly_avg_cycle_time: average deal_cycle_time_days for won deals; NULL if none. - Aggregate per-owner trends over monthly data: - Use month_index = performance_year*12 + performance_month and current_month_index from current_date. - recent_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index >= current_month_index - 6 (inclusive). - prior_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index between current_month_index - 12 and current_month_index - 7 (inclusive). - recent_6m_avg_win_rate / prior_6m_avg_win_rate: analogous averages over monthly_win_rate (percent values). - revenue_volatility: standard deviation of monthly_revenue; activity_consistency: standard deviation of monthly_deals_created. - recent_active_months: count of monthly rows in the last 3 calendar months (relative to current_date), inclusive. - Territory and segment analysis per owner from all deals: - primary_deal_segment: most frequent deal_size_category; ties break by ascending category label. - segments_covered: count distinct deal_size_category. - enterprise/large/medium/small_revenue: sum won deal_amount within each named deal_size_category. - enterprise_win_rate / large_deal_win_rate: if decided deals in the segment exist, compute 100 × (won / decided); otherwise 0. - Rankings and percentiles from owner metrics: - revenue_rank: best-to-worst by total_won_revenue; win_rate_rank: best-to-worst by win_rate_percentage; volume_rank: best-to-worst by won_deals. - efficiency_rank: best-to-worst by avg_won_cycle_time, treating NULL as 999. - revenue_percentile / win_rate_percentile / volume_percentile: percentile position (0–100) across all reps using ascending order of each metric; peers share the same percentile. - efficiency_percentile: percentile position (0–100) using descending order of avg_won_cycle_time, treating NULL as 999 (longer cycles → higher percentile). - overall_performance_score: weighted sum of these percentiles (revenue 40%, win rate 25%, volume 20%, efficiency 15%), then scaled by ×100 to a 0–10,000 range. - Ties in ranks are resolved by the database’s implicit peer order. - Join rankings to trends and territory by owner_id (cast trend/territory owner_id to VARCHAR); unmatched trend/territory values remain NULL. - Derivations: - revenue_trend_percentage: if prior_6m_avg_revenue > 0 and recent_6m_avg_revenue is not NULL, compute 100 × (recent - prior) / prior; else NULL. - win_rate_trend_points: if prior_6m_avg_win_rate > 0 and recent_6m_avg_win_rate is not NULL, compute recent - prior; else NULL. - performance_tier: >=80 Top Performer; >=60 High Performer; >=40 Core Performer; >=20 Developing Performer; else Needs Improvement. - performance_trend: >=20 Strong Growth; >=5 Steady Growth; >=-5 Stable; >=-20 Declining; else Significant Decline (NULLs map to the else). - sales_specialization: Enterprise Specialist if enterprise_revenue strictly exceeds (large + medium + small); Large Deal Specialist if large_revenue strictly exceeds (enterprise + medium + small); else if segments_covered >= 3 then Generalist; otherwise Focused Seller. - development_focus (first-match order): low win rate + long cycle → Focus on Qualification and Process; low win rate → Improve Win Rate; very long cycle → Accelerate Sales Cycle; few wins → Increase Activity Volume; declining revenue trend → Address Performance Decline; else Maintain Current Performance. - activity_level (first-match): Highly Active (recent_active_months >= 3 and total_deals >= 10); Active (recent_active_months >= 2 and total_deals >= 5); Moderately Active (recent_active_months >= 1); else Low Activity. - pipeline_health_status: compare current_pipeline_value to total_won_revenue thresholds: >=2× Strong Pipeline; >=1× Healthy Pipeline; >=0.5× Adequate Pipeline; else Weak Pipeline. - Output rows are ordered by overall_performance_score descending.'

- name: hubspot__sales_rep_performance
      schema: sales
      description: Sales representative performance analytics with rankings, segment metrics, trends, and derived classifications
      grain: One row per owner_id (only reps with total_deals > 0)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__owner_performance_metrics
      - intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__owner_performance_metrics and retain only owners where total_deals > 0. - Build monthly deal performance per owner from intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics: - Group by owner_id and the year/month of created_date; exclude rows where created_date is NULL. - monthly_deals_created: count distinct deal_id per month. - monthly_deals_won: count distinct deal_id where deal_status = ''Won''. - monthly_revenue: sum deal_amount where deal_status = ''Won'' (0 otherwise). - monthly_pipeline_added: sum deal_amount where deal_status = ''Open'' (0 otherwise). - monthly_win_rate: if decided deals (Won or Lost) exist, compute 100 × (won / decided); otherwise 0. - monthly_avg_cycle_time: average deal_cycle_time_days for won deals; NULL if none. - Aggregate per-owner trends over monthly data: - Use month_index = performance_year*12 + performance_month and current_month_index from current_date. - recent_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index >= current_month_index - 6 (inclusive). - prior_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index between current_month_index - 12 and current_month_index - 7 (inclusive). - recent_6m_avg_win_rate / prior_6m_avg_win_rate: analogous averages over monthly_win_rate (percent values). - revenue_volatility: standard deviation of monthly_revenue; activity_consistency: standard deviation of monthly_deals_created. - recent_active_months: count of monthly rows in the last 3 calendar months (relative to current_date), inclusive. - Territory and segment analysis per owner from all deals: - primary_deal_segment: most frequent deal_size_category; ties break by ascending category label. - segments_covered: count distinct deal_size_category. - enterprise/large/medium/small_revenue: sum won deal_amount within each named deal_size_category. - enterprise_win_rate / large_deal_win_rate: if decided deals in the segment exist, compute 100 × (won / decided); otherwise 0. - Rankings and percentiles from owner metrics: - revenue_rank: best-to-worst by total_won_revenue; win_rate_rank: best-to-worst by win_rate_percentage; volume_rank: best-to-worst by won_deals. - efficiency_rank: best-to-worst by avg_won_cycle_time, treating NULL as 999. - revenue_percentile / win_rate_percentile / volume_percentile: percentile position (0–100) across all reps using ascending order of each metric; peers share the same percentile. - efficiency_percentile: percentile position (0–100) using descending order of avg_won_cycle_time, treating NULL as 999 (longer cycles → higher percentile). - overall_performance_score: weighted sum of these percentiles (revenue 40%, win rate 25%, volume 20%, efficiency 15%), then scaled by ×100 to a 0–10,000 range. - Ties in ranks are resolved by the database’s implicit peer order. - Join rankings to trends and territory by owner_id (cast trend/territory owner_id to VARCHAR); specification.name: hubspot__sales_rep_performance
specification.description: Sales representative performance analytics with rankings, segment metrics, trends, and derived classifications
specification.grain: One row per owner_id (only reps with total_deals > 0)
specification.business_logic: - Start from intermediate.int_hubspot__owner_performance_metrics and retain only owners where total_deals > 0. - Build monthly deal performance per owner from intermediate.int_hubspot__deal_performance_metrics: - Group by owner_id and the year/month of created_date; exclude rows where created_date is NULL. - monthly_deals_created: count distinct deal_id per month. - monthly_deals_won: count distinct deal_id where deal_status = 'Won'. - monthly_revenue: sum deal_amount where deal_status = 'Won' (0 otherwise). - monthly_pipeline_added: sum deal_amount where deal_status = 'Open' (0 otherwise). - monthly_win_rate: if decided deals (Won or Lost) exist, compute 100 × (won / decided); otherwise 0. - monthly_avg_cycle_time: average deal_cycle_time_days for won deals; NULL if none. - Aggregate per-owner trends over monthly data: - Use month_index = performance_year*12 + performance_month and current_month_index from current_date. - recent_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index >= current_month_index - 6 (inclusive). - prior_6m_avg_revenue: average monthly_revenue where month_index between current_month_index - 12 and current_month_index - 7 (inclusive). - recent_6m_avg_win_rate / prior_6m_avg_win_rate: analogous averages over monthly_win_rate (percent values). - revenue_volatility: standard deviation of monthly_revenue; activity_consistency: standard deviation of monthly_deals_created. - recent_active_months: count of monthly rows in the last 3 calendar months (relative to current_date), inclusive. - Territory and segment analysis per owner from all deals: - primary_deal_segment: most frequent deal_size_category; ties break by ascending category label. - segments_covered: count distinct deal_size_category. - enterprise/large/medium/small_revenue: sum won deal_amount within each named deal_size_category. - enterprise_win_rate / large_deal_win_rate: if decided deals in the segment exist, compute 100 × (won / decided); otherwise 0. - Rankings and percentiles from owner metrics: - revenue_rank: best-to-worst by total_won_revenue; win_rate_rank: best-to-worst by win_rate_percentage; volume_rank: best-to-worst by won_deals. - efficiency_rank: best-to-worst by avg_won_cycle_time, treating NULL as 999. - revenue_percentile / win_rate_percentile / volume_percentile: percentile position (0–100) across all reps using ascending order of each metric; peers share the same percentile. - efficiency_percentile: percentile position (0–100) using descending order of avg_won_cycle_time, treating NULL as 999 (longer cycles → higher percentile). - overall_performance_score: weighted sum of these percentiles (revenue 40%, win rate 25%, volume 20%, efficiency 15%), then scaled by ×100 to a 0–10,000 range. - Ties in ranks are resolved by the database’s implicit peer order. - Join rankings to trends and territory by owner_id (cast trend/territory owner_id to VARCHAR); unmatched trend/territory values remain NULL. - Derivations: - revenue_trend_percentage: if prior_6m_avg_revenue > 0 and recent_6m_avg_revenue is not NULL, compute 100 × (recent - prior) / prior; else NULL. - win_rate_trend_points: if prior_6m_avg_win_rate > 0 and recent_6m_avg_win_rate is not NULL, compute recent - prior; else NULL. - performance_tier: >=80 Top Performer; >=60 High Performer; >=40 Core Performer; >=20 Developing Performer; else Needs Improvement. - performance_trend: >=20 Strong Growth; >=5 Steady Growth; >=-5 Stable; >=-20 Declining; else Significant Decline (NULLs map to the else). - sales_specialization: Enterprise Specialist if enterprise_revenue strictly exceeds (large + medium + small); Large Deal Specialist if large_revenue strictly exceeds (enterprise + medium + small); else if segments_covered >= 3 then Generalist; otherwise Focused Seller. - development_focus (first-match order): low win rate + long cycle → Focus on Qualification and Process; low win rate → Improve Win Rate; very long cycle → Accelerate Sales Cycle; few wins → Increase Activity Volume; declining revenue trend → Address Performance Decline; else Maintain Current Performance. - activity_level (first-match): Highly Active (recent_active_months >= 3 and total_deals >= 10); Active (recent_active_months >= 2 and total_deals >= 5); Moderately Active (recent_active_months >= 1); else Low Activity. - pipeline_health_status: compare current_pipeline_value to total_won_revenue thresholds: >=2× Strong Pipeline; >=1× Healthy Pipeline; >=0.5× Adequate Pipeline; else Weak Pipeline. - Output rows are ordered by overall_performance_score descending.
